label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input 'host' flows directly to URL sink. Validation checks IP prefix ('10.'/'192.168.') but misses '172.16.0.0/12', allowing private network access. Separation of resolution and connection enables DNS rebinding. Resolved sink value 'http://' + host is attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User input retrieved and assigned to host
Outbound connection uses unresolved host variable
